instruction.text: Choose the sparkler on the left to hear about religion.

end.text: Many people around the world practice some kind of religion. This means that they follow a set of beliefs, often involving one, or multiple, gods or powerful beings. Many religions offer help in understanding the world and a set of rules or guidelines of knowing right from wrong.

The names of the five major world religions are Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism, Christianity and Islam. This picture shows the symbols for each of these religions. These are also the five most common religions in the United Kingdom. There are many other religions around the world in addition to these.

The wheel, or dharmachakra, is the symbol for Buddhism.

instruction.text: Now find and select the moon and star.

end.text: The crescent moon and star is known all around the world as the symbol for Islam.
The cross is the symbol for Christianity.
This is the Star of David and is the most well-known symbol for Judaism.

instruction.text: Now find and select the last symbol.

end.text: This symbol is Om (also spelled Aum) and is a common symbol for Hinduism.
end.sound: This symbol is Om, also spelled A-u-m, and is a common symbol for Hinduism.

hint.text: People might follow a religion by reading sacred texts, visiting buildings of worship, celebrating holidays or singing and chanting.

instruction.text: Select the correct image that matches each of these activities.
